_note: An individual's own payment to the notified pension scheme, "a deduction not exceeding ₹50000" (s.124(3), p.160), with a parent's or guardian's deposit to a minor's account, "the aggregate amount of deduction under sub-section (3) and this sub-section shall not exceed ₹50000" (s.124(4)). No amount counted under s.123 counts here, nor the reverse (s.124(5), (10)): EMPLOYEE_NPS enters as what DED-SCHEDULE-XV's sub-cap left. The new regime computes total income without "Chapter VIII other than the provisions of sections 124(1) and 124(2), or 125(2) or 146" (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227) — s.124(3)–(4) are not named, so the old regime only. TY 2026-27 and TY 2025-26. rulebook DED-NPS-SELF-001, -002, DED-NPS-MINOR-001. The 1961 counterpart, s.80CCD(1B), is the TY 2025-26 version (W-075d1). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80CCD(1B) (thc p.339): "whether or not any deductions is allowed under sub-section (1), of the whole of the amount paid or deposited … which shall not exceed fifty thousand rupees", nothing allowed under (1) counting again; Finance Act, 2025 s.17(a) (p.22, w.e.f. 1-4-2026, so AY 2026-27): "shall also be allowed, where any payment or deposit is made to the account of a minor … by the assessee, being the parent or guardian of such minor, subject to the condition that the aggregate amount of deduction under this sub-section shall not exceed fifty thousand rupees" — the same row. Old regime only (s.115BAC(2)(i)). sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md B6, M17. D-144.
